description:
Quarterly maintenance reminder. Upper-bounds policy (see AGENTS.md
"Dependency Upper Bounds") caps the highest-risk deps to catch breaking
majors in CI rather than silently in `uv sync`. This item exists so the
bounds don't rot and quietly block legitimate upgrades.

Run every quarter:
  1. `uv run -- python scripts/check_dependency_bounds.py --report-only`
     - single source of truth for bounds health (same script the release
     gate uses; see quality-gate-dependency-bounds-in-release-automation).
  2. `uv lock --upgrade --dry-run` to see what would resolve without caps.
  3. For each capped dep flagged ceiling-minus-one: check the upstream
     changelog for the next major; decide bump vs hold.
  4. Bump bounds ONLY after validating on the new major (fast suite +
     standards suite). Never reactively.
  5. Remove bounds that no longer protect against real risk (e.g. a dep
     has stabilized its API).

preserves.behavior: Bounds policy (cap only high-risk, document rationale) unchanged
Fast test suite still green after any bound change
